mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let’s just take a moment to notice the thread running through everything we’ve explored: the simple, quiet power of saying, “I guess I haven’t learned that yet.” Life is always going to hand us questions we don’t have answers for. But choosing to stay open—to keep learning, to stay curious, and to show ourselves some kindness—makes all the difference. So, what can you carry forward from all this? First, being open to not knowing is actually where real growth begins. Curiosity? That’s what helps us see uncertainty as a chance to discover, not something to fear. When you let go of old patterns, you make space for new possibilities to show up. And don’t forget—self-compassion and a little bit of vulnerability are what truly connect us and help us heal. Leaning on others, asking for help, and building community—those are true sources of strength. And even when things are tough, there’s joy to be found in the small, everyday moments. Change isn’t something you “solve” once and for all; it’s a practice, a way of being as you move through life. To bring this all together, remember: you don’t have to have it all figured out. Feeling uncertain isn’t a flaw—it’s an open door. Every moment of not knowing is an invitation to be curious, to connect, and to grow. Be gentle with yourself. Allow room for mistakes, for questions, and for slow progress. Trust that you’re learning, even when it’s messy or awkward. And know this: you’re never alone—everyone is learning as they go. So keep moving forward with openness, curiosity, and grace. Your next step? It’s enough.
